moments.title: European Athletics Championships Finale
moments.blurb: The European Athletics Championships are currently underway in Birmingham, featuring top European athletes competing across various track and field disciplines, concluding this Sunday.

angles.name: Championship Buzz
angles.copy: Europe's best are battling it out in Birmingham! The European Athletics Championships are in full swing, with finals approaching. Who are you backing for gold? #EuroAthletics

angles.name: Birmingham Spotlight
angles.copy: The eyes of Europe are on Birmingham this week as our city hosts the European Athletics Championships! Incredible atmosphere at Alexander Stadium. #BirminghamAthletics

moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day at Lord's
moments.blurb: The men's and women's finals of The Hundred, the 100-ball cricket competition, will take place this Sunday, August 16th, at Lord's Cricket Ground in London.

angles.name: Cricket Showdown
angles.copy: It's Finals Day for The Hundred this Sunday at Lord's! Who will lift the trophy in the men's and women's competitions? Get ready for some epic 100-ball action!

angles.name: Welsh Fire Hope
angles.copy: Will Welsh Fire be making it to Lord's for The Hundred finals this Sunday? The competition is heating up! Keep an eye on the scores!

moments.title: FA Community Shield at Wembley
moments.blurb: The traditional curtain-raiser for the English football season, the FA Community Shield, will see the Premier League champions face the FA Cup winners at Wembley Stadium on Saturday, August 15th.

angles.name: Football's Back
angles.copy: The Community Shield is this Saturday! Football's back at Wembley as the Premier League and FA Cup winners battle it out. Who's taking home the first silverware of the season?

angles.name: Wembley Opener
angles.copy: Wembley lights up this Saturday for the Community Shield! The first big game of the season in London – get ready for some football action!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's Chart Reign
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the UK Official Singles Chart Number 1 spot for an incredible 20th consecutive week.

angles.name: Chart Dominance
angles.copy: 20 weeks at Number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still dominating the UK Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'. Is it one of the longest reigns ever?

angles.name: Unstoppable Track
angles.copy: Can anyone stop Sam Fender & Olivia Dean? 'Rein Me In' is an absolute phenomenon, making history on the Official Singles Chart. What a track!

moments.title: Madonna & Kylie's 'Love Sensation'
moments.blurb: Madonna and Kylie Minogue's highly anticipated collaboration 'Love Sensation' is set to be this week's highest new entry on the Official UK Singles Chart, eyeing a Top 10 spot.

angles.name: Pop Royalty Unite
angles.copy: It's finally here! Madonna and Kylie Minogue's 'Love Sensation' is heading straight for the Top 10. Pop royalty uniting – what do you think of the track?

angles.name: Chart Impact
angles.copy: A huge new entry from Madonna and Kylie! 'Love Sensation' is making waves on the UK Singles Chart. Expect to hear this one a lot.

moments.title: Carabao Cup Second Round Draw
moments.blurb: The draw for the Carabao Cup Second Round has been completed, with Premier League teams entering the competition and some exciting matchups confirmed for the week commencing August 24th.

angles.name: Cup Draws
angles.copy: Carabao Cup Second Round draw is done! Some big Premier League names are in, and the road to Wembley has officially begun. Who got the toughest tie?

angles.name: Exeter's Cup Journey
angles.copy: Exeter City could be facing Coventry City in the Carabao Cup Second Round! The draw has been made, with games coming up in the week of August 24th. Big local interest!

moments.title: London Bids for 2029 World Athletics
moments.blurb: UK Sport has officially submitted London's bid to host the 2029 World Athletics Championships, aiming to bring the prestigious event back to the capital.

angles.name: Global Stage
angles.copy: London wants to host the World Athletics Championships in 2029! A huge bid has been submitted – could we see the world's best track and field stars back in the UK?

angles.name: London's Legacy
angles.copy: Bringing the World Athletics Championships back to London in 2029 would be massive! Here's hoping the bid is successful. #LondonSport

moments.title: Summer Holidays Drawing to a Close
moments.blurb: School summer holidays are wrapping up across the UK, with Wales finishing today and Scotland returning to school tomorrow, while England and Northern Ireland continue for a few more weeks.

angles.name: Back to School Vibes
angles.copy: The summer holidays are almost over for many! Wales finishes today and Scotland goes back tomorrow. How was your summer break?

angles.name: Welsh Summer Ends
angles.copy: That's it for the summer holidays in Wales! Back to school from today for many. Hope you all had a fantastic break!

moments.title: Happy 50th Birthday, Ben Gibbard
moments.blurb: Ben Gibbard, frontman of Death Cab for Cutie and co-founder of The Postal Service, turns 50 today.

angles.name: Indie Icon at 50
angles.copy: Happy 50th Birthday to indie legend Ben Gibbard! From Death Cab for Cutie to The Postal Service, his songs have soundtracked so many moments. What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Happy 71st Birthday, Joe Jackson
moments.blurb: English musician, singer-songwriter Joe Jackson, known for hits like 'Is She Really Going Out with Him?', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: New Wave Legend
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to the brilliant Joe Jackson! A true new wave icon with a timeless back catalogue. What's his best song?

moments.title: Happy 77th Birthday, Mark Knopfler
moments.blurb: Mark Knopfler, legendary guitarist and frontman of Dire Straits, celebrates his 77th birthday tomorrow, August 12th.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the incredible Mark Knopfler turns 77! Happy Birthday to the Dire Straits legend and one of the finest guitarists ever. What's your favourite Dire Straits track?

moments.title: Happy 63rd Birthday, Sir Mix-A-Lot
moments.blurb: Rapper and producer Sir Mix-A-Lot, best known for his iconic hit 'Baby Got Back', turns 63 tomorrow, August 12th.

angles.name: 90s Hip-Hop Icon
angles.copy: Tomorrow, Sir Mix-A-Lot celebrates his 63rd Birthday! The man behind 'Baby Got Back' – a true 90s icon. What a tune!

moments.title: Happy 42nd Birthday, James Morrison
moments.blurb: British singer-songwriter James Morrison, known for his soulful voice and hits like 'You Give Me Something', celebrates his 42nd birthday on August 13th.

angles.name: Soulful Singer
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 42nd Birthday to the incredible James Morrison on August 13th! His voice is just pure magic. What's your favourite song?

moments.title: Happy 67th Birthday, Feargal Sharkey
moments.blurb: Feargal Sharkey, known for his distinctive voice as frontman of The Undertones and a successful solo career, turns 67 on August 13th.

angles.name: Teenage Kicks & Beyond
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to Feargal Sharkey on August 13th! From The Undertones to 'A Good Heart', what a voice! #FeargalSharkey

moments.title: Happy 81st Birthday, Steve Martin
moments.blurb: Comedy legend, actor, and accomplished banjo player Steve Martin celebrates his 81st birthday on August 14th.

angles.name: Wild and Crazy Guy
angles.copy: He's still a wild and crazy guy! Happy 81st Birthday to the incredible Steve Martin on August 14th. A true entertainer! #SteveMartin

moments.title: Happy 37th Birthday, Joe Jonas
moments.blurb: Joe Jonas, pop sensation from the Jonas Brothers and DNCE, celebrates his 37th birthday on August 15th.

angles.name: Pop Star Turns 37
angles.copy: Happy 37th Birthday to Joe Jonas on August 15th! From boyband heartthrob to pop-funk king, what's your favourite Joe Jonas era?

moments.title: Happy 25th Birthday, Tones and I
moments.blurb: Australian singer-songwriter Tones and I, known for her global hit 'Dance Monkey', turns 25 on August 15th.

angles.name: Dance Monkey Turns 25
angles.copy: Happy 25th Birthday to Tones and I on August 15th! Can you believe it's been that long since 'Dance Monkey' took over the world?

moments.title: Happy 57th Birthday, Donnie Wahlberg
moments.blurb: Donnie Wahlberg, member of New Kids on the Block and actor, celebrates his 57th birthday on August 17th.

angles.name: Blockhead Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 57th Birthday to Donnie Wahlberg on August 17th! NKOTB legend and all-round entertainer. What's your favourite New Kids track?
